description: This file defines classes and structures related to OFDM modulation, including configuration parameters, symbol and slot modulators, and their interfaces, for use in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: ofdm_symbol_modulator
classes.description: Abstract class for OFDM symbol-level modulation, providing interfaces for symbol size retrieval, frequency setting, and modulation.

classes.name: ofdm_slot_modulator
classes.description: Abstract class for OFDM slot-level modulation, providing interfaces for slot size retrieval and modulation.

methods.name: get_symbol_size
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for a given symbol index, including cyclic prefix.

methods.name: set_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets the center frequency for the modulator, thread-safe, effective on next modulation call.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Performs OFDM modulation on input grid data, producing time domain signal.

methods.name: get_slot_size
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for a given slot index.
